name: Instagram Obscura MCP

scope.account: Personal-account browser workflow after manual login
scope.login: Visible Playwright login; subsequent Instagram/CDN traffic via Obscura
scope.analysis: Local FFmpeg and multilingual Whisper prepare sampled frames and original-language speech transcripts. The host assistant interprets images and can translate or explain.
scope.platform_validation: Windows: real-engine validation; other platforms require separate compatibility verification.

limitations: Unofficial and experimental; website compatibility can change.
No dedicated publishing or Direct-sending APIs; real sends and publications were not release-tested.
No dedicated OCR or translation engine in the server.
Speech recognition and language coverage vary; support for every language is not guaranteed.
Saved results represent loaded content, not a guaranteed full archive.
notice: Project facts for discovery, not an MCP registry manifest. This document does not prove external registration or search ranking.
